race.comment: DOOO DONT THINK (3) showed plenty of fight to score last time out over 1780m at this track, getting home by just 2 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Needs to be at his best to beat this field but he is up to the challenge. MAJOR SLIP UP (2) is racing well with four top-five finishes in succession, the latest effort a second at Albion Park over 1660m. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Leading hope in a similar assignment. COURAGEOUS LEO (8) is in the mix following a fourth at his most recent appearance over 1660m at Albion Park. ROSARITO (1) is worth some thought based on his second over 1780m at this track two runs ago.
